Results.ReviewText: Solid grill. Easy to clean, heats up fast and has plenty of cooking space. Two things I don’t love: first, the shelf is not my favorite as is just rests on top of the grate rather than having a designed spot to hook in. Second, the thermometer location is not ideal. If you have the coals to one side as I usually do to set up two zones, the best place for the lid vent is opposite to the coals.  This puts the thermometer directly over the coals which throws off the reading. Overall, the grill is a great buy and preforms very well.  Also, the lid holder and the ash catcher make this grill much more functional than the base model.
Results.Title: Great grill for beginners and seasoned cooks

Results.ReviewText:
I absolutely love my Weber 22” Master-Touch Kettle. It’s way easier and faster to use than I expected for charcoal cooking. It heats up quickly, holds temperature well, and gives me way more control than I thought a kettle grill could.

Adding wood chips for extra flavor has been a game changer. The smoky taste it adds to everything from steaks to burgers to chicken is unreal. It gives food that real backyard barbecue flavor without any hassle.

Overall, this grill makes cooking over charcoal simple, fun, and seriously rewarding. If you’ve been on the fence about switching to charcoal, this is the one that will convince you.
Results.Title: First Time Charcoal Griller

Results.ReviewText: My wife gave me a 22" Master Touch for Christmas. It replaces a 20+ year old 22" Weber Kettle which is still going strong. She also got the Heat Controller cone & ring and a new cover. It went together super easy in about 30 min. I like how it's taller than my old Weber Kettle. Also like the ash bin. My old one didn't have one Fired it up first time Christmas day and grilled steaks for Christmas dinner. I used the Heat Controller cone to sear the steaks. They turned out great. Tonight, I cooked chicken wings using the cone again they were out of this world. You can't go wrong with the Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: I love these things! I’ve used Weber Kettles for years and have always loved them.  They cook evenly and hold temperature so well. They last forever.  I got this one because I wanted some color in the lineup. The only downside to a kettle is the cooking space but it’s not like you don’t know that going in. I own a few of these just so I’m able to cook more at a time, as I do some minor catering as a side hustle.  If you’re thinking about getting a one, go for it!  You’ll love it!
Results.Title: Weber Kettle Rocks!

Results.ReviewText:
The quality is top-notch, and the cooking performance is phenomenal. I've had the pleasure of hosting numerous backyard BBQs, and this grill has been the star of the show every time.

I must mention that I initially received the grill with some parts missing, but Weber's customer service was outstanding. They reached out to me promptly, apologized for the inconvenience, and shipped the missing parts immediately. Kudos to Weber for standing behind their product!



The construction is sturdy, and the grill is easy to assemble and clean. The ash-catching system is a genius feature, making cleanup a breeze. I wish they still include the char basket as it was in the past instead of the char rail.

I've read many great reviews from other Master Touch owners, and I'm thrilled to add my voice to the chorus. This grill is a worthwhile investment for any BBQ enthusiast.
Results.Title: A Sizzling Success: Weber Master Touch 22 inch BBQ

Results.ReviewText: First Kettle Grill by Weber I had purchased smokers in the past and have been grilling for more than 50 years I have enjoyed watching the many videos about the grill with all the tips from customers My first cook lived up to my expectations however I do not personally like relying all the gadgets to check the meat temperature as there must be an advantage to cooking this way for so many years This has been one of the best gifts to myself as U have had so much fun already
Results.Title: 1st Weber Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText:
All my BBQs have always been Weber, and there’s a reason for that — they’re just built to last. The quality, the service, and how well they hold up over the years is honestly impressive.
One of the biggest reasons I stick with Weber is how rust-resistant they are. I live close to the coast where the salty wind eats most metal alive, but my Webers have survived beach-front conditions without rusting or falling apart. That says a lot about their build quality.

If you want something solid, dependable, and made to last, you can’t go wrong with this BBQ. Weber nailed it again.

 5 stars — tough, reliable, and cooks like a dream.
Results.Title: Great Product

Results.ReviewText: The Master-touch 22” charcoal grill is not as good of a grill as I have come to expect from Weber.  During assembly, the holes on one the legs did not align with the push in alignment pins.  In addition, I hate the grill grate that has a removable center.  Maybe I am not using it correctly, but I definitely prefer the grate with the hinged sections on either side.  The removable center portion is hard to align correctly, especially when you have a fire going.  Defiantly, more difficult to tend to your charcoal fire than it needs to be.  I will be replacing my grill grate.  The ash removal system is pretty good, and easy to use.  Save money and just buy the original Weber Kettle.  The bells and whistles that Weber is charging for do not enhance the product.  Too much money for minimal to no gain in performance.
Results.Title: Master-touch is not in a master class.

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
